item.title: Extreme weather has spurred national blood supply shortage — here’s how to help
item.description: <p>Citing extreme winter weather conditions, the American Red Cross has warned of a severe national blood shortage.</p><p>More than 400 blood drives nationally were affected by severe weather, causing thousands of blood donations to go uncollected, the organization said Jan. 20.</p><p>In the last month, the Red Cross said it has seen a 35% decrease in blood supply.
